metadata.description: Claude Code skills by sjlee42. Korean-first agent skills for application writing and AI tool discovery.

plugins.name: write-with-me
plugins.description: Interview-based writing partner for evaluated documents (cover letters, hackathon/contest/internship applications, grant proposals). Researches the program and its judges with subagents, interviews you one question at a time, drafts only from your own words, then runs a blind multi-judge review (Claude, plus optional Codex and Antigravity). Korean-first.

plugins.name: tool-finder
plugins.description: Finds existing AI tools for a need instead of a keyword: MCP servers, Claude skills, Claude Code plugins, n8n workflows and GitHub agents. Splits the request into capabilities, searches several directories at once (official MCP registry, skills.sh, n8n, GitHub, plugin catalogs), checks without installing that each candidate still exists and is not broken (deleted paths, unpublished dependencies, recent breakage issues), and proposes combinations that cover every capability, with proof when nothing fits. Korean-first.
